reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it focuses on Avalanche chart analysis, possible entry zones, price scenarios, and trading strategy. The possible 436% profit is presented as a probability rather than a certainty, and the description states that no profit guarantees or promises are made. Affiliate commissions for marked links are disclosed, with no required payment or deceptive condition described.

opening.argument: Judge, the projected return is tied to a concrete path for viewers to trade Avalanche. The speaker says a buyer could more than double their investment at a proposed exit point, then identifies a partner exchange where viewers can buy or trade the asset. The 436% scenario strengthens the attraction. Even though the figures are conditional, the pairing of a purchase route and striking potential gains makes this more than detached market commentary.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to chart analysis and a conditional 436% figure. Those qualifications matter, but they do not erase the purchase route: the speaker also directs viewers to a partner exchange for buying or trading Avalanche. Nor does disclosing affiliate commissions resolve whether the return discussion steers viewers toward that route. The question is how the analysis and solicitation work together, not whether every projected gain is guaranteed.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited exchange link shows a disclosed way to trade, not a deceptive purchase condition. The speaker says he has not bought Avalanche and is waiting for lower zones; he also calls the 436% outcome uncertain. Those facts undercut the claim that viewers are being promised appreciation for buying through his link.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The title uses an emphatic missed-buy-zone warning; the speaker highlights a possible 436% gain; and viewers are told they are missing trading setups unless they join the linked group. The description also offers a fee discount for a trading platform. None proves fraud alone, and the profit figure is qualified, but the combined presentation can make speculative token buying feel both consequential and readily actionable.

A careful judge should weigh those invitations alongside the chart analysis, rather than treating the risk disclaimer as the whole message.

opening.argument: Judge, the chart lesson also functions as a participation funnel. The speaker introduces the video as a look at buying points and personal strategy, then moves viewers toward a group posting setups and spot purchases and a partner exchange where they can trade Avalanche. Later he describes when he would take out his investment after a 100% price increase. The technical analysis supplies the rationale; the linked destinations supply ways to act on it. That promotional role deserves weight even though the video includes cautionary analysis.

The absence of a required payment does not make those participation prompts irrelevant.
